screen_signal.definition: The same axis, fixed-other-bit, role and load regresses in at least two distinct base streams. Multiple value siblings from one stream count once.
screen_signal.interpretation: Descriptive development screen only; no significance, recurrent-damage or architecture-necessity claim.

error_value_matches.interpretation: Exact output-value matches only. Matching another entity/version value does not identify the responsible representation, erase operator or Attention address.

interpretation: Native full-history developmental screen at fixed record count and aligned token positions. Four base streams with related value siblings, loads and queries. Functional regressions do not identify a damaged pathway or demonstrate a need for joint architecture changes. NLL-only shifts are descriptive.
